title: COP Accounting Transaction Event
description: Event type for balanced transaction commitment and settlement. All postings must balance exactly within (resourceType, unit, accountingDomain).

transaction_type.description: Type of transaction. 'commitment' reserves for later settlement, 'settlement' fulfills a commitment, 'direct' is atomic.

postings.description: At least two postings required. Sum of debits must equal sum of credits for the same (resourceType, unit, accountingDomain).

unit.description: Unit for this transaction. All postings must use this unit. Implied from postings if all match.

purpose.description: Purpose or description of this transaction.

category.description: Transaction category for classification and reporting.

settlement_reference.description: For settlement transactions, reference to the prior commitment.

commitment_transaction_id.description: Transaction ID of the original commitment.

fulfillment_amount.description: Amount being settled if different from commitment.

consumes_reservations.description: Reservation IDs being consumed by this transaction.

effective_at.description: When the transaction takes effect. Defaults to event timestamp.

conversion_rate.description: Explicit conversion rate if this involves cross-unit conversion with explicit authorization.
